newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn cattle market steady-firm - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn cattle market steady-firm - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were steady to firm, compared with Monday's close, USDA said. Trade moderate. Demand moderate. Seller interest light to moderate. Offerings light.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1150-1300 lbs 69.00-70.00 many 70.00 couple lds 68.25.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1050-1200 lbs 69.00-70.00 many 70.00, couple lds 68.25.
On a carcass basis (weight only), compared with Monday's close, slaughter steers and heifers were firm.

Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1150-1300 lbs 110.00 few 111.00. Holstein - (weight only) Select to mostly Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs 102.00-103.00 1500 lbs 104.00. Holstein - (grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs 1250-1400 lbs
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1050-1200 lbs 110.00
